pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'bonjour' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good evening
   B. Pleased to meet you
   C. goodbye
   D. hello, good day

2. What does 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How do you spell it?
   B. My name is Amina.
   C. How are you?
   D. What is your name?

3. What does 'Et toi ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. How are you?
   C. How do you spell it?
   D. And you?

4. What does 'la porte' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the chair
   B. the door
   C. the book
   D. the ball

5. What does 'la salle de bain' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the window
   B. the bathroom
   C. the house
   D. the fridge

6. What does 'le canapé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sofa
   B. the bed
   C. the bedroom
   D. the bag

7. How do you say 'Happy birthday!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai neuf ans.
   B. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.
   C. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   D. Bon anniversaire !

8. What does 'une chanson' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a song
   B. a candle
   C. a balloon
   D. a month

9. Which month is 'juin'? (1 mark)
   A. April
   B. June
   C. January
   D. August

10. How do you say 'They are oranges.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je mange une mangue.
   B. J'aime la mangue.
   C. Ce sont des oranges.
   D. C'est une banane.

11. How do you say 'In the morning, I eat bread.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je bois un jus.
   B. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   C. Le matin, je mange du pain.
   D. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?

12. What does 'le magasin' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the rug
   B. the garden
   C. the shop
   D. the key

13. Read: Amina: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Kamau: Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Amina: Merci ! Kamau: De rien ! Question: What does Amina want to find? (1 mark)
   A. the church
   B. the shop
   C. the house
   D. the school

14. Which little word goes with 'canapé' (the sofa)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. les
   D. la

15. Fill in: Le ballon est ______ la porte. (behind) (1 mark)
   A. entre
   B. devant
   C. sur
   D. derrière

16. Fill in: Le chat est ______ le lit et la porte. (between) (1 mark)
   A. dans
   B. sur
   C. sous
   D. entre

17. Which little word goes with 'tomate' (the tomato)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. les

18. Fill in: Elle est ______. (short) (1 mark)
   A. petite
   B. noirs
   C. petit
   D. longs

19. Which little word goes with 'soleil' (the sun)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. les

20. What does 'Il fait beau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I stay in the house.
   B. It is hot.
   C. The weather is nice.
   D. Tomorrow the weather is nice.

21. What does 'Il fait chaud.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is the weather like?
   B. It is cloudy.
   C. I stay in the house.
   D. It is hot.

22. How do you say 'Pleased to meet you' in French? (1 mark)
   A. bien
   B. bonjour
   C. Enchanté
   D. merci

23. How do you say 'the brother' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le père
   B. la famille
   C. la grand-mère
   D. le frère

24. How do you say 'the bedroom' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la chambre
   B. le frigo
   C. la chaise
   D. la douche

25. Fill in: Dans le salon, il y a un ______. (1 mark)
   A. lit
   B. frigo
   C. gâteau
   D. canapé

26. How do you say the month 'October' in French? (1 mark)
   A. mars
   B. octobre
   C. août
   D. juin

27. How do you write the number 19 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente et un
   B. dix-neuf
   C. vingt
   D. deux

28. How do you say 'the tooth' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la dent
   B. la main
   C. le cou
   D. les cheveux

29. How do you say 'The weather is nice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait froid.
   B. Il pleut.
   C. Il y a des nuages.
   D. Il fait beau.

30. How do you say 'Turn' in French? (1 mark)
   A. De rien
   B. Allez
   C. Excusez-moi
   D. Tournez

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into French: 'In the morning, I eat bread.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into English: 'Qui est-ce ?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

33. Translate into French: 'It is cloudy.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'Touch your nose!' (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'On Sunday, I rest.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Complete the dialogue with words from the bank: ______ ! Je ______ Amina. Et toi ? (bank: Bonjour, m'appelle) (2 marks) (2 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'Where is the key?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Translate into French: 'I have ten fingers.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'Thank you very much!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Translate into English: 'Touche ton nez !' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Explain how you read the word salut aloud. Say which letter is silent. (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Describe a friend in three sentences in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'Tomorrow it is Thursday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Give three French greetings and say when you would use each one. (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'De rien !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Tournez à droite.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Il y a du vent.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Le lit est dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'He has short hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — hello, good day
   bonjour means hello, good day.

2. D — What is your name?
   Comment tu t'appelles ? means What is your name?.

3. D — And you?
   Et toi ? means And you?.

4. B — the door
   la porte means the door.

5. B — the bathroom
   la salle de bain means the bathroom.

6. A — the sofa
   le canapé means the sofa.

7. D — Bon anniversaire !
   Happy birthday! in French is Bon anniversaire !

8. A — a song
   une chanson means a song.

9. B — June
   juin means June.

10. C — Ce sont des oranges.
   They are oranges. in French is Ce sont des oranges.

11. C — Le matin, je mange du pain.
   In the morning, I eat bread. in French is Le matin, je mange du pain.

12. C — the shop
   le magasin means the shop.

13. D — the school
   Où est l'école ?

14. B — le
   canapé is masculine, so we say le canapé.

15. D — derrière
   Derrière means behind.

16. D — entre
   Entre means between.

17. A — la
   tomate is feminine, so we say la tomate.

18. A — petite
   For a girl, we add e: petite.

19. A — le
   soleil is masculine, so we say le soleil.

20. C — The weather is nice.
   Il fait beau. means The weather is nice.

21. D — It is hot.
   Il fait chaud. means It is hot.

22. C — Enchanté
   Pleased to meet you in French is Enchanté.

23. D — le frère
   the brother in French is le frère.

24. A — la chambre
   the bedroom in French is la chambre.

25. D — canapé
   A sofa belongs in the living room.

26. B — octobre
   October in French is octobre.

27. B — dix-neuf
   19 in French is dix-neuf.

28. A — la dent
   the tooth in French is la dent.

29. D — Il fait beau.
   The weather is nice. in French is Il fait beau..

30. D — Tournez
   Turn in French is Tournez.
